parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const source=String(r.source_content||r.input?.source_content||'').trim();const targets=r.targets||r.input?.targets||[];const ai=r.ai_result||r.input?.ai_result||null;if(!source||!Array.isArray(targets)||!targets.length) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C4-F',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'MISSING_REPURPOSE_INPUT',message:'source_content and targets[] are required.'},next_action:'provide_source_and_targets'}}];if(!ai){const request={task:'repurpose_content',source_content:source,targets:targets.map(t=>({id:t.id||t.channel,channel:t.channel||'generic',constraints:t.constraints||{}})),output_schema:{outputs:'array<{id,content,confidence}>'}};return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C4-F',component_version:'v1',stage:'llm_request_ready',llm_request:request,next_action:'execute_via_c2_k',error:null}}];}const outputs=Array.isArray(ai.outputs)?ai.outputs.map(o=>({id:o.id||null,content:String(o.content||''),confidence:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(o.confidence??0.5)))})):[];const missing=targets.map(t=>t.id||t.channel).filter(id=>!outputs.some(o=>o.id===id&&o.content));return [{json:{success:outputs.length>0&&missing.length===0,component_id:'C4-F',component_version:'v1',stage:'normalized',outputs,missing_targets:missing,manual_review_required:true,next_action:missing.length?'repair_missing_outputs':'send_to_approval_gate',error:missing.length?{code:'INCOMPLETE_REPURPOSE_OUTPUT',message:'One or more target outputs are missing.'}:null}}];
